actions.description: Durably fence the failed primary and atomically promote the replica
actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
/nix/store/3n4qphl9s728sz8frmpqqrv9b1m87g68-python3-3.14.7/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os
import socket
from pathlib import Path

base = Path('/var/lib/failover')
failed = base / 'primary.failed'
fenced = base / 'primary.fenced'
role = base / 'replica.role'
upstream = base / 'upstream'

if not failed.exists():
    raise SystemExit('refusing promotion: primary.failed is missing')
try:
    with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', 8081), timeout=0.5):
        raise SystemExit('refusing promotion: old primary is still listening')
except (ConnectionRefusedError, TimeoutError, OSError):
    pass

actions.description: Verify promoted public API and preserved customer data
actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
base=http://127.0.0.1:8080
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

get() { curl --silent --show-error --max-time 3 --output "$work/body" --write-out '%{http_code}' "$1"; }
status=$(get "$base/health"); test "$status" = 200; test "$(cat "$work/body")" = ready
status=$(get "$base/role"); test "$status" = 200; test "$(cat "$work/body")" = primary
for pair in \
  'customer-red-4a7|red-original' \
  'customer-blue-8d2|blue-original' \
  'customer-green-f31|green-original'; do
  id=${pair%%|*}; expected=${pair#*|}
  status=$(get "$base/records/$id"); test "$status" = 200; test "$(cat "$work/body")" = "$expected"
done
